newsitem.title: USA: Pitt-Des Moines says enters not guilty plea.
newsitem.headline: Pitt-Des Moines says enters not guilty plea.

text.p: Pitt-Des Moines Inc said Tuesday it has entered a plea of not guilty to a two-count misdemeanor indictment alleging it violated safety regulations in connection with a 1993 accident that killed two workers.
The accident occurred at the U.S. Postal Service building site in Chicago. A grand jury has charged the company with violating safety regulations at the site.
The company said it has asked for a jury trial. Pitt-Des Moines said it also believes it will be found innocent of the alleged federal safety violations.
On November 3, 1993, crews from the company were erecting the fifth floor of Chicago's new post office when a portion of the building collapsed.
Two workers, one of them a Pitt-Des Moines employee, were killed in the accident and five others were injured.
